task_reconstruction.official_task: Plan a national charging network and date the switch to all-electric cars.

section_map.summary: Summary answers the five questions in order.
Supercharger treated as an M/M/1 desk.
Handout gives each country type its own factor.

contributions.summary: A connectivity rate based on a 170 mile range.
A lag index relating charger construction to sales.

dependency_graph.handoff: the waiting time that becomes an objective of the allocation
the station plan whose timeline the regression dates

assumptions.summary: Built stations stay, and arrivals are Poisson.
Density above 150 is urban, 50 to 150 suburban, below 50 rural.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Ownership per capita from a cited US statistic.
Station locations taken from the Tesla site.

models.summary: Logistic share from three surviving indexes.

verification.summary: Six indexes tested in SAS; three kept.
Station count recomputed across two parameter rows.

results_trace.summary: Share of 10 percent in 2024 and 90 percent in 2069.
Stations fall to 1,701,980 at 9.0 chargers per station.

writing_logic.summary: The solver output is printed, then read in words.
Each country type gets its own factor.

language_observations.summary: Questions answered in the order asked.
Each assumption ends with a because clause.
A category named by its leading country.

visualization_observations.summary: Table 1 gives station counts for three regions and the total.
Table 2 lines up market share against year.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A year for each share makes the ban date checkable.

independent_extensions.summary: Pick one definition of the lag index and recompute the charger-versus-sales comparison.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Ownership and range taken from named sources.
Indexes dropped when the SAS test fails.
Lag index kept in three disagreeing forms.
Summary rounding kept beside the exact count.
Countries grouped, each group with its factor.
Lag index ties construction to sales.

unresolved_questions: The lag index is defined three ways in one section. All three kept.
The summary says about 1.7 million stations; the body prints 1,704,500. Both kept.
The service rate mu is used in the queue formula but never numbered.
